title: Part Three: The CIA and the Mossad

sections.brief: The liaison 1951–1967: Ben-Gurion and Bedell Smith, Angleton's 'administrative anomaly', the Khrushchev speech, Soviet hardware, Amit–McNamara 1 June 1967; what each side received. Figures: fig-time (1951–2026).

The CIA's own record of concern: NUMEC 1968–78 (officially unresolved), the 1979 report seized in Tehran and Israel's denial, Davitt, the 1987 Pollard damage assessment; how CIA knowledge stopped at referral. Figures: fig-compare.

Wye River 1998, Olympic Games/Stuxnet (Sanger), Burns–Barnea hostage channel 2023–24, Gofman–Ratcliffe 2026, post-7 October sharing, the 2024 drone-feed cutoff, and the absence of US oversight of Israeli use. Figures: fig-flow (how liaison works).
